# Read the offer letter before it reads you.

> Free employment contract and job offer checker: paste the offer letter or agreement and see the non-compete, invention assignment, signing-bonus repayment, equity buyback, forfeited bonus, arbitration and salary-mismatch red flags, each with the change to ask for. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
